$note: Written by hand, never generated. JsonProjectionContractTests runs every row.

compile: a source node's output of term `source` (default Json?) wired into `into` with `projection` (null: a direct wire without one; `literal`: a literal mapping holding it). `expect` is the set of rule ids the compile reports; `term` is the effective term of the target input, `binding` the target's type parameter bindings.

into: `input` is a block input of that declared term ($T names a type parameter of the block); `passthrough` a passthrough name of a block with no inputs; `workflowOutput` a root output port of that term.

run: the projection evaluated over a source value with P = `term` (the conversion to the input is the binder's, tested apart). `source` is the value, `sourceText` its raw JSON text (repeated member names, which no projection reads: the source is refused as narrowing), `sourceNull` a source holding null. `expect` is the value (as the term's JSON form), `absent` (absent at the wire) or the `category` of json-projection-failed.

Every run row but one marked `wireOnly` also runs through jsonPath (jsonPathText when `mode` is jsonText), with `source` as the value of a Json? read: it gives the same value or category, and null where the wire is absent (the jsonPath expression reads the same Json? source).

expression: a call `jsonPath(${previous.s.Out}, path, type)`, `jsonPathText` when `mode` is jsonText, typed over a Json? read. `expect` is the set of rule ids its typing reports and `term` the term of the call; `hostTypes` registers those names.
